find_characters.description: Find Disney characters by name, or by a film, short film, TV show, video game, or park attraction they appear in, or by alignment. Every filter is optional, matches its text anywhere in the value ignoring case (so 'donald' finds Donald Duck and Angel Donald), and all the filters given must match.
find_characters.name: find_characters

parameters.description: Only characters whose name contains this (for example, Donald Duck).
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Only characters in a film whose title contains this (for example, Tangled or Hercules (film)).
parameters.name: films

parameters.description: Only characters in a short film whose title contains this (for example, Tangled Ever After).
parameters.name: short_films

parameters.description: Only characters in a TV show whose title contains this (for example, DuckTales).
parameters.name: tv_shows

parameters.description: Only characters in a video game whose title contains this (for example, Kingdom Hearts III).
parameters.name: video_games

parameters.description: Only characters in a theme park attraction whose name contains this (for example, Celebrate the Magic).
parameters.name: park_attractions

parameters.description: Only characters whose alignment contains this (for example, Good or Bad). Only a few dozen characters have one recorded.
parameters.name: alignment

parameters.description: Which page of results to return, starting at 1 (defaults to the first page). A page past the last one returns no characters.
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: How many characters to return per page, from 1 to 100 (defaults to 50).
parameters.name: page_size

characters.description: One page of the characters that match.

data.description: The characters on this page. Empty when nothing matches or the page is past the last one.

items.description: One character, and everything the API records about it.

_id.description: The character's id, e.g. 308. Get a character takes it.

alignment.description: Whether the character is good, bad or neutral, in the wiki's words (e.g. 'Good' or 'Bad, later good'). Null for most characters, which have none recorded.

allies.description: Characters recorded as its allies. Almost always empty: the API records allies for very few characters.

enemies.description: Characters recorded as its enemies. Almost always empty: the API records enemies for hardly any characters.

films.description: The films the character appears in, e.g. 'Tangled' or 'Hercules (film)'.

imageUrl.description: A link to the character's picture on the Disney Fandom wiki, or null when it has none.

parkAttractions.description: The theme park attractions the character appears in, e.g. 'Celebrate the Magic'.

shortFilms.description: The short films the character appears in, e.g. 'Tangled Ever After'.

tvShows.description: The TV shows the character appears in, e.g. 'Once Upon a Time'.

url.description: The character's own link in the Disney API.

videoGames.description: The video games the character appears in, e.g. 'Kingdom Hearts III'.

info.description: Where this page sits among the results.

count.description: How many characters are on this page.

nextPage.description: The API's link to the next page of these results, or null on the last page. Page takes the page number, not this link.

previousPage.description: The API's link to the previous page of these results, or null on the first page. Page takes the page number, not this link.

totalPages.description: How many pages the results fill at this page size. With a page size of 1 it is the number of characters that match.

get_character.description: Get a single Disney character by its numeric id. An id the API does not have fails the step.
get_character.name: get_character

parameters.description: The numeric id of the character (for example, 308 for Queen Arianna). The other actions return it as each character's '_id'.
parameters.name: character_id

description: Look up Disney characters using the free, keyless Disney API: browse the character catalog, find characters by name or by a film, show, game, or park attraction they appear in, fetch a single character by id, or pick one at random. No account or API key required. Disclaimer: this is an independent integration with the community-run Disney API (disneyapi.dev).
